title: introduce kms-delegate-rotation-hook-and-sealedsecret-reconciler-for-safe-key-rollover
author: Maya Chen
description: Problem: On private (VPC/on-prem) deployments we rotate KMS/HSM wrapping keys regularly. Existing sealed-secrets assets in clusters and stored backups are not automatically re-encrypted when a new KMS wrapping key is promoted, which causes unnecessary manual work during key rollovers and can lead to brief service disruptions during operator-driven rotations. Motivation: Automate safe re-encryption of SealedSecrets and provide a Terraform/Helm friendly hook so rotations can be coordinated from the control plane without human intervention. This PR introduces two pieces: 1) a lightweight controller 'sealedsecret-reconciler' that watches SealedSecret and Secret pairs and re-encrypts sealed payloads with the currently-active KMS key. 2) A 'kms-delegate-rotation-hook' Terraform module and Helm post-upgrade Job template that invokes the KMS rotation sequence and kicks the reconciler to perform staged rewrapping. Implementation highlights: - sealedsecret-reconciler: Go controller (controller-runtime) running as an opt-in Deployment in the private-installer chart. It observes a cluster-level ConfigMap containing the active-wrapping-key metadata and runs rewrap operations against SealedSecrets in a namespace-safe, rate-limited fashion. Rewraps are idempotent and include a short TTL on per-secret lock annotations to avoid thundering herds. - kms-delegate-rotation-hook: Terraform module (modules/kms_rotation_trigger) which emits a rotation token into the installer control plane (sealed in Vault or sent to the delegated KMS operator). The Helm chart includes a templated Job that, when triggered, posts a rotation event to the controller's endpoint and monitors progress via CR status. - Rollout safety: Controller performs a 3-stage rewrap (namespace batches -> 10% concurrency -> full) configurable via values.yaml. It respects bypass labels (redwood.io/skip-rewrap) and namespace allowlists. - Failure modes: On transient KMS errors the controller retries with exponential backoff and emits Prometheus metrics and events. If a rewrap set fails beyond retry limits, the controller marks a RotationStatus CR and creates a diagnostics Secret with a compact failure report. - Backups: As part of the hook we emit a pre-rotation sealed backup to a user-configurable Bucket/Vault path; post-rotation we create a verification manifest that lists rewrap checksums. - Security and audit: All rewrap operations are logged to the cluster audit log and to the installer control plane audit sink (when configured) including key fingerprint and operator identity. We never persist plaintext secrets outside ephemeral containers. - Testing: unit tests for controller logic and integration harness using KinD + Vault emulator. End-to-end smoke tests were added to the installer's CI pipeline (post-deploy rotations against a test KMS) and are gated behind the 'rotation' CI profile. Checklist: - [x] controller core, RBAC, and Helm hooks - [x] Terraform module + examples in examples/tf/kms-rotation - [x] integration tests (KinD + Vault) - [x] metrics, events, and audit logging - [x] docs (UPGRADING_ROTATIONS.md and chart README) - [x] staged rollout config and bypass labels Migration notes: - Default behavior is disabled. Operators must opt in via values: sealedsecretReconciler.enabled = true and provide delegateKMS config. - When enabled, the reconciler will only act on SealedSecrets created after the configured cutoff timestamp unless the operator explicitly triggers a full rewrap. Follow-ups (future PRs): - Add HSM PKCS#11 provider plugin for in-cluster operations (planned ENG-4279) - Automated validation against existing encrypted backups (UX improvements) - A CRD-driven UI in Console to visualize rotation progress Related: ENG-3321 (rotation playbook), SRE-198 (incident from manual rewrap).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice work overall. A few nits: 1) can we make the default batch window smaller in CI to speed up tests? 2) please call out cost implications for large clusters in the docs.
Maya Chen: Responding: reduced CI batch window to 2 namespaces and added doc note about estimated API calls per-namespace.
Priya Desai: Security question: how do we ensure the reconciler cannot be tricked into rewrapping secrets with an attacker-supplied key? Please add validation of key fingerprints.
Maya Chen: Added fingerprint check and a flag sealedsecretReconciler.keyValidation.required=true; unit tests added.
Rajat Kumar: Approving after the fingerprint validation and the minor lint fixes are addressed.
CI Bot: rotation-integration (kind + vault-emulator) passed on run #3 after flakes fixed.
Release Manager: Marked as safe for backport to release/2026-02 for customers running automated rotations.
QA: Verified basic end-to-end on k8s 1.26, Vault 1.15 emulator; no plaintext leaks observed in logs.
release_notes: Add opt-in sealedsecret rewrap controller to automate key rotations for sealed secrets.
Terraform module to trigger delegated KMS rotation and coordinate Helm post-upgrade jobs.
Default disabled. Operators MUST enable and configure delegate KMS details before use.
Provides audit logging, metrics, and failure diagnostics to aid incident triage.
